description: This file declares the SensorsSimulator class and associated data structures for simulating sensor data, including methods for updating sensor states and retrieving serialized sensor data.

classes.name: SensorsData
classes.description: A structure representing sensor data with a 3D vector and a float value.

classes.name: SensorsSimulator
classes.description: A class for simulating sensor behavior, updating sensor data based on rotation, and retrieving serialized sensor data.

methods.name: SensorsSimulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sensor simulator, possibly with auto mode.

methods.name: RefreshSensors
methods.description: Updates sensor values based on new rotation angles x, y, z.

methods.name: GetSensorsData
methods.description: Returns serialized sensor data as a string, filtered by a sensor bitmask.
